    #Yeni ürünler

    Dosya: theme/bloklar/yeni-urunler.html · Ham dosya · Smarty

    {if $HEADER==1}

<div class="fl col-12 home-vitrin" id="tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID}">

  {if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1}

  <div class="fl col-12 mt">

    <div class="vitTitle pos-r with-border border-limited border-custom-pink text-bold block-title mb">

      <div class="btn vitTitle">{$BLOCK_TITLE}</div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="pos-r fl col-12 mt mb">

    <div class="col">

      <div class="row tabBtns">

        {foreach $TAB_LIST as $T}

        <div class="col p-left">

          <div class="btn btn-custom-gray btn-small{if $T.SELECTED==1} active{/if}" data-id="{$T.ID}">{$T.TITLE}</div>

        </div>

        {/foreach}

      </div>

    </div>

    {if $DISPLAY_COMPARISON_BUTTON == 1}

    <a class="compare pos-a pos-top pos-right col-sm-12 a-center btn btn-small btn-custom-pink text-description text-regular pr pl p-top p-bottom" id="productComparison{$BLOCK_ID}">

      <i class="icon-comparison"></i>

      {#compare_selected#}

    </a>

    {/if}

  </div>

  {else}

  <div class="fl col-12 mt mb">

    <div class="pos-r with-border border-limited border-custom-pink text-bold text-center block-title mb">

      <div class="btn">{$BLOCK_TITLE}</div>

      {if $DISPLAY_COMPARISON_BUTTON == 1}

      <a class="compare pos-a pos-top pos-right col-sm-12 a-center btn btn-small btn-custom-pink text-description text-regular pr pl p-top p-bottom" id="productComparison{$BLOCK_ID}">

        <i class="icon-comparison"></i>

        {#compare_selected#}

      </a>

      {/if}

    </div>

  </div>

  {/if}

  <div class="col col-12{if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1} showcaseWrap{/if}" data-parent="{$BLOCK_ID}">

    <div class="row mb catalogWrapper">

      {if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1}

      <div class="col col-12 showcase" id="tab-{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}">

        <div class="row">

          <div class="fl col-12">

            <ul class="fl col-12 notClear" id="list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}">

              {else}

              <div class="fl col-12"> 

                <ul class="fl col-12 notClear" id="list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}">   

                  {/if}

                  {/if}

                  {if $LOOP==1}

                  <li class="fl col-2 col-md-3 col-sm-6 col-xs-6 ease">

                    <div class="col col-12 productItem">

                      <input type="hidden" class="myProductList" value="{$P.ID}"/>

                      <div class="row">

                        <a href="/{$P.URL}" class="image-wrapper fl{if $P.IMAGE_LIST.1.SMALL != ''} imgGallery{/if}">

                          <span class="imgInner">

                            <img {if $IS_LAZY_LOAD_ACTIVE == '1'}data-src="{$P.IMAGE.SMALL}" src="{$LAZY_LOAD_LOADING_IMAGE}" class="lazy" {else}src="{$P.IMAGE.SMALL}" class="active" {/if}alt="{$P.BRAND} - {$P.TITLE}" title="{$P.BRAND} - {$P.TITLE}" />

                          </span>

                          {if $P.IMAGE_LIST.1.SMALL != ''}

                          <span class="imgInner">

                            <img {if $IS_LAZY_LOAD_ACTIVE == '1'}data-src="{$P.IMAGE_LIST.1.SMALL}" src="{$LAZY_LOAD_LOADING_IMAGE}" class="ease ndImage lazy" {else}src="{$P.IMAGE_LIST.1.SMALL}" class="ease ndImage" {/if} alt="{$P.BRAND} - {$P.TITLE} (1)" title="{$P.BRAND} - {$P.TITLE} (1)" />

                          </span>

                          {/if}

                        </a>

                        <div class="box col-12 productDetails loaderWrapper">

                          <div class="row">

                            <div class="box col-12">

                              <div class="row">

                                <a href="/{$P.URL}" title="{$P.TITLE}" class="col col-12 productDescription">{$P.TITLE}</a>

                              </div>

                            </div>

                            <div class="box col-12">

                              <span class="col col-12 productBrand">

                                {if $DISPLAY_BRAND == 1}

                                <a href="/{$P.BRAND_URL}" title="{$P.BRAND} {$P.TITLE}" class="col col-12 productBrand">{$P.BRAND}</a>

                                {/if}

                              </span>

                              <div class="fl col-12 productComment">

                                <div class="stars">

                                  <div class="fl stars-inner" style="width:{$P.COMMENT_RANK}%;"></div>

                                </div>

                              </div>

                            </div>  

                            <div class="box col-12">

                              <div class="fl col-12 tooltipWrapper">

                                <div class="productPrice col-12 fl">

                                  {if $P.DISCOUNT_PERCENT > 0 && $P.IS_DISPLAY_DISCOUNTED_ACTIVE == 1}

                                  <div class="fl productDiscount">%{$P.DISCOUNT_PERCENT}</div>

                                  {/if}

                                  <div class="priceWrapper">

                                    <div class="currentPrice {if $P.DISCOUNT_PERCENT > 0}currentPrice2{/if}">

                                      {vat price=$P.PRICE_SELL vat=$P.VAT} {$P.TARGET_CURRENCY}

                                    </div>

                                    {if $P.DISCOUNT_PERCENT > 0 && $P.IS_DISPLAY_DISCOUNTED_ACTIVE == 1}

                                    <div class="discountedPrice">

                                      {vat price=$P.PRICE_NOT_DISCOUNTED vat=$P.VAT} {$P.TARGET_CURRENCY}

                                    </div>

                                    {/if}

                                  </div>

                                </div>

                                <div class="fl col-12 dn-xs">

                                  <input type="hidden" id="Adet{$P.ID}{$BLOCK_ID}" name="Adet{$P.ID}{$BLOCK_ID}" value="{$P.MIN_ORDER_COUNT|default:1}" />

                                  {if $DISPLAY_CART_BUTTON == 1}

                                  <a onclick="Add2Cart({$P.ID}, $('#subPro{$P.ID}{$BLOCK_ID}').val(), $('#Adet{$P.ID}{$BLOCK_ID}').val());" class="fl col-12 basketBtn2" data-parent="{$P.ID}{$BLOCK_ID}">Sepete Ekle</a>

                                  {/if}

                                </div>

                              </div>

                            </div>

                          </div>

                        </div>

                      </div>

                    </li>

                    {/if}

                    {if $FOOTER==1}

                    {if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1}

                  </ul>

                </div>

                <div class="col slideControl" id="productControl{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}">

                  <div class="row">

                    <span id="prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}" class="fl colPrev icon-arrow-left icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>       

                    <span id="nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}" class="fr colNext icon-arrow-right icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>       

                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            {else}

          </ul>

        </div>

        <div class="col slideControl" id="productControl{$BLOCK_ID}">

            <span id="prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}" class="fl colPrev icon-arrow-left icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>

            <span id="nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}" class="fr colNext icon-arrow-right icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>

        </div>

        {/if}

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <script type="text/javascript">

    $(document).ready(function(){       

      $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID}').equalizer();   

      {if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1}        

      $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} #tab-{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}').addClass('current');    

      $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} .btn[data-id="{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}"]').addClass('active');      

      $('#list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}').slide({ 

        slideType : 'carousel',         

        slideCtrl : {           

          showCtrl: true, 

          wrapCtrl: '#productControl{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}',    

          nextBtn: '#nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}',    

          prevBtn: '#prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}{$TAB_LIST[0].ID}'     

        }   

      }); 

      {else} 

      $('#list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}').slide({  

        slideType : 'carousel', 

        slideCtrl : {           

          showCtrl: true,     

          wrapCtrl: '#productControl{$BLOCK_ID}', 

          nextBtn: '#nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}',     

          prevBtn: '#prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}'      

        }       

      }); 

      {/if}   

    }); 

    {if $TAB_LIST|@count > 1}       

    $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} .tabBtns .btn').click(function(){        

      if(!$(this).hasClass('active')){        

        $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} .showcase.current').removeClass('current');  

        $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} .active').removeClass('active');     

        var btnId = $(this).attr('data-id');        

        $.ajax({            

          url:'/srv/service/showcase/tab/{$BLOCK_ID}/'+ btnId,    

          success: function(tabContent){          

            if($('.showcaseWrap[data-parent="{$BLOCK_ID}"] #tab-' + btnId).length < 1){     

              tabContent =    '<div class="col col-12 showcase" id="tab-' + btnId + '">' +    

                '<div class="row">' +

                  '<ul class="fl col-12 notClear" id="list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId + '">' +

                    tabContent +

                    '</ul>' +

                    '</div>' +

                    '<div class="col slideControl" id="productControl{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId + '">' +

                      '<div class="row">' +

                        '<span id="prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId + '" class="fl colPrev icon-arrow-left icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>' +

                        '<span id="nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId + '" class="fr colPrev icon-arrow-right icon-no-space icon-custom-gray"></span>' +

                        '</div>' +

                        '</div>' +

                        '</div>';

                        $('.showcaseWrap[data-parent="{$BLOCK_ID}"] > .row').append(tabContent);    

                        lazyControl('lazy');    

                        $('#list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId).equalizer();     

                        $('#list-slide{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId).slide({  

                          slideType : 'carousel',         

                          slideCtrl : {                       

                            showCtrl: true, 

                            wrapCtrl: '#productControl{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId, 

                            nextBtn: '#nextProduct{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId,     

                            prevBtn: '#prevProduct{$BLOCK_ID}' + btnId  

                          }                           

                        });     

                      }   

                      $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} #tab-' + btnId).addClass('current');     

                      $('#tab-vitrin-{$BLOCK_ID} .btn[data-id="' + btnId + '"]').addClass('active');  

                    }           

                  });     

                }       

              });     

              {/if}

            </script>

            {/if}
